notes:
Unbox Client 0.2.18

- Discover is now available from the sidebar, with grouped categories and multi-select filtering.
- Browse Modrinth mods, resource packs and shaders; choose an install profile and review required dependencies before downloading. Friend profiles remain read-only.
- Improved skin library: preserve your current account skin, switch Classic/Slim arms, and open the in-game wardrobe from the title screen.
- Restored the always-available update checker and grave mining crack feedback.
- Integrated multiplayer invitations into Minecraft's native server list and included the VoxLink direct-connection transport.

Networking update (2026-10-22 UTC): P2P signaling is now live. Production signaling, VoxLink transport with a loopback fixture, and automatic fallback through a real e4mc relay passed two-client checks on one Mac. Cross-network NAT success rates and Windows gameplay still need testing.

Platforms: macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
